title: Elytra Replacer
description: Allows you to replace the elytras contained in end ships with any other item in the game!
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d388931f2ea7f9d1c59fdc3b4e66241a434a1ee5.png) # Elytra Replacer It does what it says on the tin there isn't much else too it. I just wanted a mod that replaced elytra drops rather than just removing elyras from the game.
Also works with existing elytras they just have to enter a player inventory directly to update.
Inventory replacement only works on players not in creative mode. ### Config In order to open the config menu run ```/function hn_elytra_user:config_menu``` from there you can configure if the pack should replace elytras in end boats, in player inventorys, and change the item that elytras are replaced with. ![Config Menu in Game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7df664cff4c4b7eb307648e9ce06252912cc4ecb_0.webp) Note : The replace item button functions instantly without having to click load config.
